notes: Finished renaming the second paid tier from Prime to Seer. The name had been changed in one place and left alone in another, so the app called the same tier two different things depending on which part of it you asked.

Themes you already have keep working. The old name still resolves, which matters more than it sounds: the lookup treats an unrecognised tier as god-mode-only, so a plain find-and-replace would have made every installed theme quietly vanish…
